exposure: Pre-pregnancy maternal weight (underweight, healthy weight, overweight, obese)
cohort: The study participants were 255,773 women who had live births in Indiana between 2008 and 2010, abstracted from the Indiana Vital Statistics registry.
finding: Maternal obesity in Indiana was associated with high risks of maternal complications, particularly obstetrical conditions of the metabolic syndrome including diabetes, hypertension, and eclampsia.
mod_finding: Maternal obesity was associated with an increased likelihood of delivering by Caesarian section and having a prior Caesarian section.
